task_completion.description: Navigate to the SuiteCRM Administration or Settings panel.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The VLM should see the 'Administration' page or the 'Tax Rates'/'Shipping Providers' links in the SuiteCRM interface.

task_completion.description: Create the 'GST - Canada' tax rate with 5% value and Active status.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A form or list view showing 'GST - Canada', '5' or '5.00', and 'Active' in the Tax Rates module.

task_completion.description: Create the 'PST - British Columbia' tax rate with 7% value and Active status.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A form or list view showing 'PST - British Columbia', '7' or '7.00', and 'Active' in the Tax Rates module.

task_completion.description: Create the 'HST - Ontario' tax rate with 13% value and Active status.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A form or list view showing 'HST - Ontario', '13' or '13.00', and 'Active' in the Tax Rates module.

task_completion.description: Create the 'Canada Post' shipping provider with Active status.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A form or list view showing 'Canada Post' with status 'Active' in the Shipping Providers module.

task_completion.description: Create the 'Purolator' shipping provider with Active status.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A form or list view showing 'Purolator' with status 'Active' in the Shipping Providers module.

integrity.description: The agent used the SuiteCRM web interface rather than direct database manipulation or terminal commands.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with CRM forms, buttons, and dropdowns.

integrity.description: The agent manually entered the specific names and values into the CRM fields.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the text being typed or pasted into the 'Name', 'Value', and 'Status' fields of the CRM.

integrity.description: The agent did not use external scripts or API calls to bypass the UI.
integrity.visual_evidence: The trajectory shows the step-by-step navigation through the CRM menus (Admin -> Tax Rates/Shipping Providers).

privileged_info_for_vlm: The agent must create three tax rates: 'GST - Canada' (5%), 'PST - British Columbia' (7%), and 'HST - Ontario' (13%), all set to 'Active'. It must also create two shipping providers: 'Canada Post' and 'Purolator', both set to 'Active'. Verification should confirm these exact strings and numerical values appear in the SuiteCRM Tax Rates and Shipping Providers modules.
